features.title: Hydro host loops
features.description: CFL, RoundCells3D, cell updater and hdsim_3d loops (portable::HostParallelFor). Kokkos builds run them on the host thread pool; other builds run them serially.

subfeatures.title: Slopes and face values (LinearGauss3D)
subfeatures.description: Device path in LinearGaussKernels.hpp, selected by LinearGauss3D::RunOnDevice; needs an EOS that runs on the device (IdealGas).

gpu.note: Nothing calls LinearGauss3D::RunOnDevice yet; call it with rich::execution::OnDevice("rich.hydro.slopes") and set available to true here.

subfeatures.title: Riemann fluxes (ConditionActionFlux1 + Hllc3D)
subfeatures.description: Runs on the device exactly when the slopes leave their face values there.

gpu.note: Follows rich.hydro.slopes; has no switch of its own.

subfeatures.title: Extensive update (ConditionExtensiveUpdater3D)
subfeatures.description: Device path in ExtensiveUpdaterKernels.hpp, selected by ConditionExtensiveUpdater3D::RunOnDevice.

gpu.note: Nothing calls ConditionExtensiveUpdater3D::RunOnDevice yet; call it with rich::execution::OnDevice("rich.hydro.update") and set available to true here.
